UPDATE /* BmsXraySendMapper.updateXraySend : XRAY판독결과 재전송 여부 업데이트 */ TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT_TEMP SET SEND_STATUS = 'T' WHERE
SEQ IN (#{item})

UPDATE /* BmsXraySendMapper.updateReleaseArrovalSend : 반출승인 재전송 여부 업데이트 */ TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN_TEMP SET SEND_STATUS = 'T' WHERE
SEQ IN (#{item})
mapper.select:
/* BmsXraySendMapper.selectXraySendBl : XRAY판독결과,반출승인 재전송 > B/L Add 리스트 조회 */
SELECT P.BL_NO , P.AR_DATE , PKG.PACKING_NO , R.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , P.SE_INSPECTION_CODE , P.INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN , P.MBL_NO , P.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN P WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT R WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.IN_PLAN_NO = R.IN_PLAN_NO INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG PKG WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.IN_PLAN_NO = PKG.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE 1=1 AND PKG.IN_CT = 1 AND PKG.DELETE_YN = 'N'
SELECT P.BL_NO , P.AR_DATE , CASE WHEN P.APPROVAL_CLASS = '31' THEN '승인' WHEN P.APPROVAL_CLASS = '1' THEN '취하' ELSE '' END AS APPROVAL_CLASS , CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),P.NOTIFY_DATE_TIME, 20) AS NOTIFY_DATE_TIME , P.OUT_APPROVAL_NO , P.OUT_CLASS , P.APPROVAL_DATE , P.MBL_NO , P.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN P WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN I WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.IN_NO = I.IN_NO WHERE 1=1
AND P.BL_NO IN (#{item})
AND P.BL_NO = #{srchNo}
AND P.APPROVAL_CLASS = '31'
AND P.APPROVAL_CLASS = '1'
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND ${srchDateGbn} <= DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat}))
mapper.insert: /* BmsXraySendMapper.insertXraySend : XRAY판독결과 재전송 B/L Add */ INSERT INTO TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT_TEMP ( REJECT_YN ,OD_JOB_NO ,BL_NO ,PACKING_NO ,XRAY_DATE ,XRAY_TIME ,XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE ,SE_INSPECTION_CODE ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,SEND_STATUS ,SELECTED_TYPE ,HOLD_YN ,CRIME_SELECTION_YN ,TIMEOUT_YN ) SELECT 'N' ,P.OD_JOB_NO ,P.BL_NO ,PKG.PACKING_NO ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 21) ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 24) ,R.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE ,P.SE_INSPECTION_CODE ,GETDATE() ,'F' ,'' ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(HOLD.HOLD_RELEASE_YN,'') IN ( 'Y','') THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END ,P.INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN ,'N' FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN P WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT R WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.IN_PLAN_NO = R.IN_PLAN_NO INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG PKG WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.IN_PLAN_NO = PKG.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT OD_JOB_NO, MIN([HOLD_RELEASE_YN]) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WITH(NOLOCK) GROUP BY [OD_JOB_NO]) HOLD ON P.OD_JOB_NO = HOLD.OD_JOB_NO WHERE P.BL_NO = #{blNo} AND PKG.PACKING_NO = #{packingNo} AND PKG.IN_CT = 1 AND PKG.DELETE_YN = 'N'

/* BmsXraySendMapper.insertReleaseArrovalSend : 반출승인 재전송 B/L Add */ INSERT INTO TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN_TEMP ( APPROVAL_CLASS ,APPROVAL_CANCEL_DATE ,APPROVAL_CANCEL_TIME ,OD_JOB_NO ,BL_NO ,OUT_APPROVAL_NO ,OUT_CLASS ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,SEND_STATUS ) SELECT P.APPROVAL_CLASS ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), P.NOTIFY_DATE_TIME, 21) ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), P.NOTIFY_DATE_TIME, 24) ,I.OD_JOB_NO ,P.BL_NO ,P.OUT_APPROVAL_NO ,P.OUT_CLASS ,GETDATE() ,'F' FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN P WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN I WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.IN_NO = I.IN_NO WHERE P.BL_NO = #{blNo}
